steps.name: build-exact-one-shot-head
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1; git checkout -B work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1 origin/work/debug-one-shot-clir-e2e-v1; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ca1952cd6b06a8ba999bd54f4ad41606e63e4727"; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon

steps.name: install-and-readiness
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'; PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null; M="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; S="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')"; test "$M" = 'SM-S906B'; test "$S" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'; adb -s "$SEL" install --no-streaming -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; for P in android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; do adb -s "$SEL" shell pm grant "$PKG" "$P"; done; adb -s "$SEL" shell run-as "$PKG" sh -c 'test -s no_backup/identity-vault-v1.bin && echo identity_vault_present=true || { echo identity_vault_present=false; exit 7; }'; MODEL='/sdcard/Android/data/pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/files/models/gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm'; if adb -s "$SEL" shell test -s "$MODEL"; then echo 'gemma4_model_present=true'; else echo 'gemma4_model_present=false'; fi; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.calls.live_call_readiness --serial "$SEL"

steps.name: launch-and-observe-real-call
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'
PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'
adb -s "$SEL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"
adb -s "$SEL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.MainActivity" >/dev/null
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, subprocess, time, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
SEL="192.168.0.100:46769"
PKG="pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge"

def run(args, timeout=8):
    p=subprocess.run(args,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout,check=False)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.replace("\r","")

def call_state():
    _,out=run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","dumpsys","telephony.registry"],10)
    vals=re.findall(r"mCallState=(\d+)",out)
    return int(vals[0]) if vals else None

def status():
    code,out=run(["adb","-s",SEL,"shell","run-as",PKG,"cat","shared_prefs/campaign_runtime_status_v1.xml"],5)
    if code!=0 or not out.strip():
        return None
    try:
        root=ET.fromstring(out)
        for node in root:
            if node.attrib.get("name")=="status":
                return (node.text or "").strip()
    except Exception:
        return None
    return None

seen=[]
last_status=None
active_seen=False
deadline=time.time()+300
while time.time()<deadline:
    st=call_state()
    if st is not None and (not seen or seen[-1]!=st):
        seen.append(st)
        print(f"call_state_transition={st}",flush=True)
    if st in (1,2):
        active_seen=True
    cur=status()
    if cur and cur!=last_status:
        last_status=cur
        print("campaign_status="+cur.replace("\n"," ").replace("\r"," ")[:500],flush=True)
    if active_seen and st==0 and cur and (
        "cleanup=" in cur.lower() or
        "success" in cur.lower() or
        "failed" in cur.lower() or
        "without accepted success" in cur.lower()
    ):
        break
    time.sleep(2)

print("active_call_observed="+str(active_seen).lower())
print("call_state_sequence="+",".join(map(str,seen)))
print("final_campaign_status="+((last_status or "missing").replace("\n"," ").replace("\r"," ")[:500]))
if not active_seen:
    raise SystemExit("real_call_was_not_observed")
PY
